runtimeVersion: Actual deployed local :3000; source/runtime identification is recorded in the main report, not inferred from the static SHA.

environment.load: No CPU/SQL/connections/lock probe for this window; concurrent background workload unknown
environment.productionActivity: Normal read-only UI, no latency/failure injection, no imports/model tasks/backup creation/real sending
environment.apiCountScope: Only paths beginning /api/; not full static assets, iframe, helper or other external traffic
environment.privacy: No response bodies, names, identifiers, raw query strings, headers, business text or screenshots in this public summary.
environment.responseBodySizeScope: Playwright responseBodySize for recorded /api/ paths, including image responses; not JSON-only bytes

timingLimitations: One entry sample per module/view; cache states differ between survey and chain samples; do not calculate a stable P95 from these.
Terminal observation includes deliberate stability waiting and double rAF; no first-new-range-paint attribution.
Network request ms is browser-observed completion; Worker/Django/SQL/JSON parse/render phase attribution unknown.
Long tasks and layout shifts available only in successful entry surveys; no same-document memory-growth or sustained resource-leak experiment.
